## Routing Decisions — Chapter 5B (Economic Wellbeing)

| chunk_id | Decision | Applicable 5B Lens | Adjacent Context | Exclusion Reason |
|----------|----------|-------------------|------------------|------------------|
| U0091 | **INCLUDE** | 5B.1, 5B.3, 5B.6, 5B.8 | U0092 (outcomes) provides implementation context; U0090 covers broader fiscal picture | Contains concrete named policy actions: 2019–2021 pension reforms, specific contribution rate changes (6.5–10% → 15% by 2030), minimum contribution year reductions (25 → 15 years phased to 20 by 2031), specific minimum pension levels (MEX$45,000 / MEX$85,000), AFORE fee caps. Distributional design across earnings levels constitutes material evidence for 5B.1 (prosperity vs rents), 5B.3 (fiscal rules), 5B.6 (budget quality), 5B.8 (distribution across classes). |
| U0092 | **INCLUDE** | 5B.1, 5B.6, 5B.8, 5B.9 | U0091 (reforms) is necessary antecedent; subsequent sections on labor market context provide backdrop | Contains measured outcomes: pension spending 1.4% GDP (2000) → 4.0% GDP (2021). Implementation findings: adverse labor market incentives, early retirement effects, informality risk from contribution increases, distributional effects of low-earner subsidies. Material evidence of actual vs intended policy outcomes. |
| U0093 | **EXCLUDE** | — | U0094 (nontariff restrictions) and U0095 (customs cooperation) provide policy-specific evidence | Topic overlap: trade percentages are generic background descriptors (1.7% exports, 0.6% imports, 5.8%/13.5% Central America exposure). Proposed gains from integration are aspirational, not documented actions or measured results. Table of contents and chart source attribution are not material evidence. |
| U0094 | **EXCLUDE** | — | U0093 (trade volume context) is background only; U0095 (customs proposal) is adjacent | Nontariff barrier graph description is chart-label / axis-label content; the "Lower number reflects fewer restrictions" note is a definition. The IMF 2017 reference is a citation, not evidence. No concrete policy action, measured outcome, cost, or distributional finding present. |
| U0095 | **EXCLUDE** | — | U0094 (nontariff restrictions) provides context; U0093 (trade data) is background | "Could go a long way," "replicate," and "would help improve" are prospective conditional language. No enacted policy, implemented action, measured result, or qualified finding. Forward-looking recommendation only. |
| U0096 | **EXCLUDE** | — | U0097 (Fund relations detail) is the substantive content following this page | Table of contents, document title page, and administrative header. No policy action, outcome, cost, attribution fact, or finding of any kind. |
| U0097 | **EXCLUDE** | — | U0098 (technical assistance schedule) provides complementary institutional context | Institutional governance content: membership status, quota amounts, FCL arrangement dates/amounts (all = 0 drawn). Meeting participant list. No economic policy action, measured outcome, or qualified finding. |
| U0098 | **EXCLUDE** | — | U0097 (arrangements) and U0100 (statistical issues) provide substantive content | "Projected payments" table shows zero principal and 0.15 SDR charges through 2026 — minimal substance. Technical assistance list is administrative record; no policy action or finding. |
| U0099 | **EXCLUDE** | — | No adjacent chunks with material content | Contains only a web URL and the heading "RELATIONS WITH THE WORLD BANK." No policy content, finding, or evidence of any kind. |
| U0100 | **EXCLUDE** | — | U0098 (technical assistance) and U0101 provide complementary institutional context | Data quality assessment methodology (2008 SNA, GFSM2014) and institutional process descriptions (ROS C missions, reconciliation exercises) are methods/process descriptions, not documented policy actions, measured outcomes, costs, or distributional results. Deficiencies noted (cash vs accrual recording, chained volume indices) are identification of measurement gaps, not qualified policy findings. |
